project.description: RFC 0066 Episode 3, layer 1 - the component base: the headless runtime every DOM-level component is built on. The CSS manager and its three helpers, the href manager and the preference steward, with the crate that declares them. Moved here file for file from homing-server, which now depends on this module: the package (hue.captains.singapura.js.homing.server) and the crate name are the old ones on purpose, so that nothing which imports the runtime - the server's injection, every studio module, every downstream repo, the conformance baseline - changes while the new structure is established. They are renamed in one sweep when the old structure retires, and not before. What arrives next, as the components that need it are cut: focus mechanics, keyboard scope, the widget scaffold, the ask channel.
